info.name: Sportsfolio Backend API v3
info.description:
Complete API collection — 70+ endpoints.

Variables:
  baseUrl = http://localhost:3001
  sessionId = token from verify-otp
  userId, teamId, tournamentId, matchId, invitationId, locationId, achievementId, requestId

🔐 AUTH RULES (Personnel system):

Manual Match flow:
  1. Create match (POST /api/matches)
  2. Add match officials (POST /api/personnel/matches/:id/personnel) — caller must be primary match official
  3. Start match (POST /api/matches/:id/start) — caller must be a match official

Tournament flow:
  1. Create tournament (POST /api/tournaments) — creator auto-added as primary tournament official
  2. Add tournament officials (POST /api/personnel/tournaments/:id/personnel) — primary official only → 403 UNAUTHORIZED_NOT_TOURNAMENT_OWNER
  3. Run matchmaking (POST /api/tournaments/:id/matchmaking) — any tournament official → 403 UNAUTHORIZED_NOT_TOURNAMENT_OFFICIAL
  4. Start any tournament match (POST /api/matches/:id/start) — match official OR tournament official
  5. Advance round (POST /api/tournaments/:id/rounds/next) — any tournament official

Scope values for GET /api/matches:
  scope=my       → matches I participate in
  scope=official → matches I officiate (direct match official OR tournament official)

Generates knockout bracket matches for a PUBLISHED tournament.
Tournament must have status=PUBLISHED.

Who can call: any Personnel with entityType=TOURNAMENT for this tournament.
Error: 403 UNAUTHORIZED_NOT_TOURNAMENT_OFFICIAL if not a tournament official.

🔐 Auth required — Tournament official only

Who can call: any Personnel with entityType=TOURNAMENT for this tournament.
Error: 403 UNAUTHORIZED_NOT_TOURNAMENT_OFFICIAL if not a tournament official.

Who can start a match:
- Manual match → only assigned match officials (Personnel with entityType=MATCH)
- Tournament match → match officials OR any tournament official (Personnel with entityType=TOURNAMENT)

Error: 400 UNAUTHORIZED_NOT_MATCH_OFFICIAL if caller has no Personnel record
